summary: The filing is a Form 6-K notice that Tencent Music Entertainment Group will hold its annual general meeting (AGM) on June 30, 2026. It includes the notice of AGM, form of proxy, and voting card for ADS holders, along with a board recommendation to vote in favor of the proposed resolutions. This is a routine shareholder meeting notification with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. The registrant is merely fulfilling its periodic reporting obligations as a foreign issuer, acting as the filer.
